taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-07, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1790.5 | 0.52 | 0.52
2 | 384.0 | 1.63 | 2.15
3 | 73.0 | 22.70 | 24.85
4 | 103.4 | 11.48 | 36.33
5 | 540.2 | 1.37 | 37.70
6 | 520.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as QHAA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station H-07, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station H-07 (Survey Area H)**

The VES interpretation yields a six-layer resistivity sequence: a resistive surface layer (1790.5 Ω·m, 0.52 m), underlain by a moderately resistive second layer (384.0 Ω·m), a low-resistivity third layer (73.0 Ω·m), a slightly higher fourth layer (103.4 Ω·m), a resistive fifth layer (540.2 Ω·m, thin at 1.37 m), and a sixth layer (520.8 Ω·m) inferred to extend to depth.

Applying the standard curve-type convention to the resistivity progression gives: layers 1-2-3 → Q (r1>r2>r3), 2-3-4 → H (r2>r3<r4), 3-4-5 → A (r3<r4<r5), and 4-5-6 → K (r4<r5>r6). This produces a curve type of **QHAK**, not the **QHAA** recorded on file — the file label does not match the computed resistivity trend for the deepest triplet (layers 4-5-6), where r5 exceeds r6, indicating a K-type segment rather than A-type.

Recommend verifying resistivity values for layers 5 and 6 before finalizing interpretation.

{"curve_type_stated": "QHAK", "label_issue_flagged": true}
